physicalNotes: Radius 0.812 +/- 0.023 solar radii from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract): 564,908 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Temperature 5005 +/- 65 K from Mancini et al. 2026, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1694 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2026A&A...712A.147M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
